_step150: the shot leaves on a tap's release (planning step 137): each tap goes down on `tick` and comes up on `release`, the next tick unless it says later
_about: ROUND 1 OF THE 3b-2 ROUTE PHASE (the knights see and shoot, planning steps 158 and 159): the one change is the ESCORT, the knight the ghost's rage calls (a minion.ent at minion_spawn_(436, 96) on the wayA waypoints 314 and 412). The earlier fireball at (418, 138) on 1160 burst on the double block's corner on 1170 and burned nothing: the escort had landed under the block on 1156 and stayed alive; it saw him walking off the block on 1222 (row 1, y 217, three buckets) and shot on 1542 and 1793, the second killing him. Now the fireball is shot ahead, flat from the block at (470, 126) on 1126 (1127 its release): it leaves the player's point at 2.08 units a tick and meets the escort falling through x 436, y 100, on 1143 (the burn; the escort falls 20 ticks from y 96 to the floor, x 436, and walks left at 1 unit a tick from 1154). Cycle 2's is on 2087 (burned 2103). The ghost's beats then follow the escort's death: the cycle 2 and 3 taps, which the earlier file timed to burns on 1163 and 2139, are 16 and 33 ticks earlier, and won on 3343 (the earlier route on 3376).
3-32, the ghost, won by three burns from barrels the ghost puts back itself, each set off by a fire diamond's fireball (planning step 117).

Re-timed for the wave 3a timing build (CK, G10, G4): the walk is 2.4 u a tick, a shot takes 1 + (D - 27.2) / 3.2 ticks, the next tap waits for it to land and for the 400 ms (26 ticks), and a held fire diamond turns every tap into a fireball, so a portal can only be shot with the diamond drained (the gutter's steam, x 242, drains it).

A portal above the diamond (tap 1, lands 89) and one at the player (tap 2, 91) put the player on the double block with it; off the block to the right, a fireball at the black knight (tap 3, burned on 327, 18 ticks after the earlier timeline's 309: the knight now walks at the original's rate): its death adds the ghost (R4), whose SHOOTING beats come on 565 and every 187.5 ticks after (753, 940, ...) and restock the barrel at barrel_spawn (190, 110) and the drained diamond.

The ghost shoots, on a beat, only at a player right of its red line (x 262); the player is left of it on every beat but one a cycle, when he stands at x 498 and the shot, fired on the beat, needs 32 ticks to reach him: he is gone through the portal pair by then (re-timed in 3b-1's round 1: the pair of cycle 1 is shot on 756, three ticks after the beat on 753, as it was after 735, and every tap from there on is 18 ticks later than on the earlier build; the taps before it, 430 to 685, keep their ticks: the barrel's portal lands on 563, two ticks before the first restock, and one shot 18 ticks later hits the falling barrel).

Each cycle: a portal at (590, 190), shot from x 376 or more (the view must show it), and one over the barrel (cycle 1: (190, 182) while the barrel falls, lands 563; cycles 2-3: (214, 205) beside the resting barrel, 22 u from its centre, which carries it through) send the barrel out beside the ghost, where it rests at (590, 205); a portal at (370, 100), shot from x 491 or more (the line then clears the double block's corner), and one at the player just after the next beat put the player on the block (756, 1716, 2675), where he takes the diamond; the fireball from (399.6, 126.4) toward (514, 160) passes the ghost and burns the barrel's top: blasts on 884, 1844 and 2803 - hp 2, 1, 0. The aim was (514, 172): from the block's end the fireball passes the double block's top-right corner (422, 144) about 8 u above it, and whether it bursts there came down to a tenth of a unit of the player's x (399.7 on cycle 1: through; 399.6 on cycle 2: it burst at (424.7, 136.4) on tick 1784 of the earlier timeline, and every aim steeper than 172 burst there too); aims at (514, 156) to (514, 163) clear it and win, (514, 165) does not.

After the first two, rage calls an escort (252 ticks after the blast: 1136, 2096) at the spawn point (436, 96), and the fireball above, from the block at (470, 126), burns it as it falls (1143, 2103); the player walks off the block to the left, through the steam (the diamond drained, 1229, 2189), and the beat 188 ticks after the burn restocks both (1336, 2296); he waits left of the line through it, and walks back to x 376 for the first portal. No knight sights him anywhere in the run (no exclamation, and the only enemy_shot are the ghost's three, on 753, 1712 and 2672): the black knight holds at x 617 facing left from 175 to about 245 while he stands at (447, 206) in its row for the first fireball, and sights nothing; on the block he is in row 0 (y 126.4, 1.6 under the line floor(y / 128) = 1 that the knights' row is on), and no escort lives to look.

Dead (the third blast on 2803, ghost_dead 2804), the ghost drops the yellow key at (488, 147) on 3026 (222 ticks after it): a portal at the key and one at the player (3063, the key held on 3066) take the player to it, then left to the keyhole (halo 3260), the locked door goes on 3310, and the door: won on tick 3343. Each later stretch of the file shifted on its own by -4 and +4 ticks wins, but the first escort's tap needs 1118 to 1134, the second's 2082 to 2091 (the cycles' own windows: 15 and 17 ticks wide). Leans on G1 (planning steps 158 and 159) and on the ghost's own shots, which this route outruns as the earlier did (enemy_shot x3, none kills).
